tools.name: lookup_brand_recommendation_rate
tools.description: Look up a brand's AI Recommendation Rate: the percentage of buyer-intent questions where AI search picks the brand first, not just mentions it. Also returns its Recommendation Inclusion Rate: how often the brand appears anywhere in the answer. Measured on ChatGPT with search enabled, refreshed month

tools.name: get_recommendation_rate_methodology
tools.description: Definitions of Recommendation Rate and Recommendation Inclusion Rate, the metrics Modern Discovery uses to measure brand recommendation in AI answers. States the AI surface measured (ChatGPT with search enabled) and the monthly refresh cadence. Use it to explain how GEO or AI search visibility is me

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
